canonical_name: Classification of connected covering spaces by subgroups of the fundamental group
source_wording: 覆盖空间与基本群的对应 (the correspondence between covering spaces and the fundamental group)
canonical_statement: Let X be path-connected, locally path-connected, and semilocally simply connected, and choose x0 in X. Pointed isomorphism classes of path-connected covering maps p : (E,e0) -> (X,x0) correspond bijectively to subgroups of pi_1(X,x0), by sending p to the image of p_* : pi_1(E,e0) -> pi_1(X,x0). After forgetting the point e0, isomorphism classes correspond to conjugacy classes of subgroups.

canonical_formal_target.environment_fingerprint: Lean 4.29.0 (98dc76e3); mathlib 8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95; exact target/import closure pending statement phase

domain_and_universes: Topological spaces X and E in Lean universes to be fixed; x0 : X and e0 : E; connected covering maps E -> X. The statement phase must select concrete predicates for path connectedness, local path connectedness, and semilocal simple connectedness.
quantifiers: for every eligible base topological space X
over pointed path-connected covering maps p : (E,e0) -> (X,x0)
hypotheses: p is a covering map and E is path-connected
p(e0) = x0 in the pointed formulation
conclusion: The induced-fundamental-group image gives a bijection between pointed covering isomorphism classes and subgroups; forgetting the chosen lift of x0 quotients the subgroup side by conjugacy.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Disconnected covering total spaces are excluded from the canonical root because they require group actions or subgroup families rather than one subgroup. Bases lacking the three stated local/connectivity hypotheses are excluded. Universal-cover existence alone, path lifting alone, and the injection of fundamental groups are consequences or prerequisites, not substitutes for classification.

alternate_encodings.target: Unpointed connected covering-space isomorphism classes correspond to conjugacy classes of subgroups of pi_1(X,x0)
alternate_encodings.relationship: quotient of the pointed correspondence by changing the lift of x0

alternate_encodings.target: All covering spaces over X correspond to pi_1(X,x0)-sets via monodromy
alternate_encodings.relationship: broader categorical formulation whose transitive objects recover connected coverings
